title: Paintings from the Chauvet cave (museum replica).jpg
author: HTO
description: Replica of the painting from the Chauvet cave, in the Anthropos museum, Brno. The original art is approximately 31,000 years old, probably Aurignacien. The group of horses probably does not picture a herd of them, but some kind of etiological study, showing, from left to right, calmness, aggression, sleep and grazing.
